article_manifest.title: Celebration of the 15th edition of African Road Safety Day: ANISER conducts a major roadside inspection operation in Niamey
article_manifest.original_title: Célébration de la 15è édition de la Journée Africaine de la Sécurité Routière : L’ANISER mène une vaste opération de contrôle routier à Niamey
article_manifest.summary: As part of the celebrations for the 15th edition of African Road Safety Day, the Nigerien Road Safety Agency (ANISER) organised a major road safety check operation in the city of Niamey on Sunday, 15 November 2020. . Conducted jointly with the National Police, the National Gendarmerie and the Municipal Police, this operation aims to ensure that road users, namely motorcyclists and motorists, comply with the Highway Code.

article_manifest.title: Kalaban-Coura: Four people arrested after the discovery of a homemade weapon
article_manifest.original_title: Kalaban-Coura : quatre personnes interpellées après la découverte d’une arme artisanale
article_manifest.summary: Kalaban-Coura : quatre personnes interpellées après la découverte d’une arme artisanale La police de Kalaban-Coura a interpellé quatre personnes dans la nuit du 14 au 15 novembre, après la découverte d’un pistolet de fabrication artisanale. Vers 2 heures du matin, une patrouille circulait dans le quartier de Garantiguibougou. Les policiers ont remarqué deux passagers d’une moto-taxi au comportement suspect.

article_manifest.title: NDLEA arrests eight cocaine couriers, recovers 634 wraps
article_manifest.original_title: NDLEA arrests eight cocaine couriers, recovers 634 wraps
article_manifest.summary: Operatives of the National Drug Law Enforcement Agency have arrested eight members of a transnational drug trafficking cartel accused of moving cocaine from Lagos through Kano, Niger Republic and Libya to Europe. The suspects, who allegedly swallowed cocaine pellets to evade security checks, excreted a total of 634 wraps weighing 13.795 kilogrammes while in NDLEA custody.

article_manifest.title: Niger: Appointment of New Secretaries General to the Ministries of Defence and the Interior
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : Nomination des nouveaux SG aux ministères de la défense et de l’intérieur
article_manifest.summary: Niamey, 17 November (ANP) – Brigadier General MAMANE SOULEY, General Officer of the Nigerien Armed Forces, has been appointed Secretary General of the Ministry of National Defence, while Colonel Major NOMA DARI has been promoted to Deputy Secretary General, according to a decree issued by the President of the Republic and made public on 16 November 2026. . At the Ministry of the Interior, Public Security and Territorial Administration, Police Commissioner General Ayouba Abdou Rahamane has been appointed Secretary General of the said ministry, according to the same source.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Nioro du Sahel: The efforts of the FAMa are helping to revive economic activity and transport
article_manifest.original_title: Nioro du Sahel : Les efforts des FAMa favorisent la reprise des activités économiques et des transports
article_manifest.summary: Nioro du Sahel, 17 November 2026 (AMAP) – The efforts of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) to improve security and facilitate the free movement of people and goods are contributing to the gradual return to normality in Nioro du Sahel. . The arrival of several dozen fuel tankers, the resumption of transport links with Bamako and Kayes, and the restocking of markets are all signs of this improvement after nine months of severe disruption.

article_manifest.title: Air Force: The fleet is gaining in heavy transport and mobility
article_manifest.original_title: Armée de l’air : la flotte gagne en transport lourd et en mobilité
article_manifest.summary: CURRENTLY From January to October 2026, the Malian Air Force carried out more than 7,000 sorties, totalling nearly 26,000 flight hours. Brigadier General Alou Boï Diarra, Chief of Staff of this component, also reported that around 28,000 passengers and more than 2,000 tonnes of cargo were transported during this period. .

article_manifest.title: Customs cooperation: Nigerian trainee officers on an immersion programme in Niamey to familiarise themselves with border security strategies
article_manifest.original_title: Coopération douanière: des officiers stagiaires nigérians en immersion à Niamey pour s’imprégner des stratégies de sécurisation des frontières
article_manifest.summary: As part of the cooperation between the customs administrations of Niger and Nigeria, thirteen (13) trainee officers from the Nigerian Customs Service (NCS) will be carrying out a study visit in Niamey from 14 to 21 November 2026, in order to analyse the experience of their counterparts from the Nigerien Directorate General of Customs (DGD) in combating transnational threats.

article_manifest.title: Mali: The FAMa target bases and...
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : les FAMa ciblent des bases et...
article_manifest.summary: Mali: The FAMa target bases and logistics depots of armed groups in Abeïbara and Sévaré The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) have carried out new precision strikes against positions of armed terrorist groups in the Abeïbara and Sévaré sectors . These operations, carried out on 14 and 16 November 2026 as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, targeted assembly points housing armed individuals and military equipment, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces.

article_manifest.title: Mali : près de 80 000 personnes refoulées de Guinée déjà rapatriées, 13 décès enregistrés
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : près de 80 000 personnes refoulées de Guinée déjà rapatriées, 13 décès enregistrés
article_manifest.summary: Le Centre de coordination et de gestion des crises (CECOGEC), organe du gouvernement malien, a annoncé le 16 novembre 2026, que 79 044 personnes refoulées de Guinée sont déjà rentrées chez elles, grâce à 522 véhicules, dont 421 camions et 101 cars. Treize décès ont par ailleurs été enregistrés au cours des opérations. Les sites de regroupement se vident : le principal site du district de Bamako commence à être démantelé, et celui de Kouremalé ne compte plus que quelques personnes.

article_manifest.title: Niger: Police Commissioner General Aboubacar Issaka Oumarou, new Director General of the National Police
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : Le Commissaire Général de Police Aboubacar Issaka Oumarou, nouveau DG de la Police nationale
article_manifest.summary: Niamey, 17 November (ANP) – Police Commissioner General Aboubacar Issaka Oumarou, formerly Director of the Central Office for the Suppression of Illicit Drug Trafficking (OCRTIS), has been appointed Director General of the National Police (DGPN), by decree signed on 13 November by the President of the Republic, Army General Abdourahamane Tiani. . With several years of experience in the field of public safety, the new Director General of the National Police has a professional career marked by significant responsibilities in Niger and abroad.

article_manifest.title: Tahoua: Significant quantity of weapons and ammunition seized in Ibecetane
article_manifest.original_title: Tahoua : Saisie d’une importante quantité d’armes et de munitions à Ibecetane
article_manifest.summary: Tahoua, 17 November (ANP) – A large quantity of weapons and ammunition has been seized by the Niger National Guard (GNN) in Ibecetane, in the Rural Commune of Akoubounou, Abalak Department (Tahoua Region). This seizure was presented to the Governor of the Region, Colonel-Major Souleymane Amadou Moussa, on Monday, 16 November 2026, on the premises of the Tahoua Regional District of the GNN.

article_manifest.title: Air Force: Over 7,000 sorties and 26,000 flight hours completed in ten months
article_manifest.original_title: Armée de l’Air : Plus de 7 000 sorties et 26 000 heures de vol réalisées en dix mois
article_manifest.summary: The Malian Air Force carried out more than 7,000 sorties, totalling nearly 26,000 flight hours between January and October 2026. During this period, it also transported around 28,000 passengers and more than 2,000 tonnes of cargo. These figures were announced on Monday, 16 November 2026, by the Chief of Staff of the Air Force, Brigadier General Alou Boï Diarra, on the occasion of the official handover of new aircraft to the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa).

article_manifest.title: ORGANISED CRIME IN SIKASSO: A FAKE SOLDIER ARRESTED
article_manifest.original_title: GRAND BANDITISME À SIKASSO : UN FAUX MILITAIRE INTERPELLÉ
article_manifest.summary: An individual who was impersonating a sergeant in the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) was arrested in Sikasso in recent days for falsely claiming a title. This arrest is reminiscent of a previous case recorded in the same town in October 2024, when a bogus customs officer was arrested for (…) By Mahamane TOURE – NOUVEL HORIZON

article_manifest.title: Mali: The FAMa carry out precision strikes against terrorist groups in Abeibara and Sévaré
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : les FAMa mènent des frappes de précision contre des groupes terroristes à Abeïbara et Sévaré
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national public that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. . On Saturday, 14 November 2026, a gathering point for armed terrorist groups, housing several individuals as well as military equipment, including vehicles and a fuel depot, was the target of precision strikes between eight (8) and ten (10) kilometres north and north-east of Abeïbara.

article_manifest.title: Mali : 13 morts parmi les personnes refoulées de Guinée
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : 13 morts parmi les personnes refoulées de Guinée
article_manifest.summary: Les refoulements de ressortissants maliens et burkinabè depuis les zones d’orpaillage de Guinée ont fait 13 morts au Mali, tandis que 79 044 personnes ont été convoyées dans le cadre des opérations de retour, selon un bilan du Centre de coordination et de gestion des crises (CECOGEC), rendu public lundi 16 novembre 2026. Ces données illustrent l’ampleur de cette crise humanitaire qui mobilise depuis plusieurs semaines les autorités maliennes et burkinabè, les services sanitaires et les organisations d’assistance.

article_manifest.title: Mali: 1,505 fuel tankers in Bamako
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : 1 505 citernes de carburant à Bamako
article_manifest.summary: In total, 1,505 tanker trucks carrying petroleum products have arrived in Bamako since the beginning of November, including 840 new vehicles recently received, according to a supply report shared by several media outlets on Monday, 16 November 2020. . This new arrival follows the receipt of 665 tankers on 7 November, under escort by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), in a context marked by persistent disruptions to hydrocarbon supply chains.

article_manifest.title: Mali-Russia: Seven new aircraft strengthen the military fleet
article_manifest.original_title: Mali-Russie : sept nouveaux aéronefs renforcent la flotte militaire
article_manifest.summary: On Monday, 16 November 2026, the Malian army took delivery of seven new aircraft acquired as part of its military cooperation with Russia, comprising one strategic transport aircraft and six helicopters, intended to strengthen its mobility, logistical transport and air support capabilities. . The handover ceremony, presided over by the Head of State, Army General Assimi Goïta, took place at Bamako-Sénou's President Modibo Keïta International Airport, in the presence of several government and military officials.

article_manifest.title: Strengthening the operational capabilities of the FAMa: The Transitional President presents new aircraft to the Air Force
article_manifest.original_title: Renforcement des capacités opérationnelles des FAMa : le président de la transition remet de nouveaux aéronefs à l’armée de l’air
article_manifest.summary: On Monday, 16 November 2020, at Modibo Keïta-Sénou International Airport, the Transitional President, Head of State and Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, Army General Assimi Goïta, officially handed over the keys to an Ilyushin IL-76 strategic transport aircraft and Mi-24 and Mi-8 helicopters to the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa). . This acquisition strengthens the operational and logistical capabilities of the national defence force.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: The army strikes terrorist positions in Abeïbara and Sévaré
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : L’armée frappe des positions terroristes à Abeïbara et Sévaré
article_manifest.summary: According to the press release, the first assembly point, located between 8 and 10 kilometres north and north-east of Abeïbara, housed several individuals as well as military equipment, including vehicles, and a fuel depot. The second, located 33 kilometres south-west of Sévaré, also housed several individuals and military equipment, including motorcycles. .

article_manifest.title: Mali: The army receives a new batch of aircraft
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : L'armée réceptionne un nouveau lot d’aéronefs
article_manifest.summary: Mali: The army takes delivery of a new batch of aircraft The Malian army is expanding its air fleet. On Monday, 16 November 2026, it took delivery of a new batch of aircraft on the tarmac of the presidential pavilion at Modibo Keita International Airport in Bamako. The Transitional President, Army General Assimi Goïta, presided over the ceremony in the presence of civil and military authorities.

article_manifest.title: Bamako: The body of a man pulled from the Niger River
article_manifest.original_title: Bamako : le corps d’un homme repêché dans le fleuve Niger
article_manifest.summary: A body was removed from the Niger River on Sunday evening, in Badalabougou, near the Martyrs' Bridge. It was fishermen who spotted it and raised the alarm. The victim is a man of about 30 years old.

article_manifest.title: African Road Safety Day: Niger focuses on discipline and strengthening checks to reduce road accidents
article_manifest.original_title: Journée africaine de la sécurité routière : Le Niger mise sur la discipline et le renforcement des contrôles pour réduire les accidents de la route
article_manifest.summary: Le Niger a célébré, le dimanche 15 novembre 2026, la 15è édition de la Journée africaine de la sécurité routière sous le thème : « Zéro tolérance sur nos routes : sensibiliser, contrôler, inspecter et réprimer ». Instituée par l’Union africaine, cette journée est observée chaque troisième dimanche du mois de novembre. Elle est couplée à la Journée mondiale du souvenir des victimes des accidents de la route, une journée officielle des Nations Unies.

article_manifest.title: STRENGTHENING OPERATIONAL CAPABILITIES: The Transitional President presents a new batch of aircraft to the Malian Armed Forces
article_manifest.original_title: RENFORCEMENT DES CAPACITES OPERATIONNELLES : le Président de la Transition remet un nouveau lot d’aéronefs aux Forces Armées Maliennes
article_manifest.summary: On Monday, 16 November 2026, the Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, Army General Assimi Goïta, presided over the official ceremony at the Presidential Pavilion of Modibo Keïta-Sénou International Airport for the handover of new aircraft to the Malian Armed Forces. This allocation reflects the desire of the highest authorities to continue efforts to modernise the defence force.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: 100 new stars to illuminate Avenue Kwame-Nkrumah
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso : 100 nouvelles étoiles pour illuminer l’avenue Kwame-Nkrumah
article_manifest.summary: One hundred Burkinabé and foreign personalities now have their stars on Avenue Kwame-Nkrumah, in the heart of Ouagadougou. Their names are engraved on stelae installed as part of the second edition of the "Street of Stars", an initiative of the Sotigui Academy. .

article_manifest.title: NATIONAL POLICE: GENERAL ABOUBACAR OUMAROU, A SEASONED OFFICER AT THE HELM
article_manifest.original_title: POLICE NATIONALE : LE GÉNÉRAL ABOUBACAR OUMAROU, UN OFFICIER CHEVRONNÉ AUX COMMANDES
article_manifest.summary: From the fight against illicit drug trafficking to command responsibilities within the National Police, Police Commissioner General Aboubacar Issaka Oumarou is taking the helm of the DGPN. His career has been marked by professional experience in Niger and in several international United Nations missions. The General Directorate of the National Police (DGPN) has a new head .

article_manifest.title: National Defence: The Air Force is strengthening its fleet with an IL-76 strategic aircraft and Mi-24 and Mi-8 helicopters
article_manifest.original_title: Défense nationale : L’Armée de l’Air renforce sa flotte avec un avion stratégique IL-76 et des hélicoptères Mi-24 et Mi-8
article_manifest.summary: STRENGTHENING THE OPERATIONAL CAPABILITIES OF THE FAMa: The Transitional President hands over new aircraft to the Air Force The Transitional President, Head of State and Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, Army General Assimi Goïta, officially handed over the keys to an Ilyushin IL-76 strategic transport aircraft and Mi-24 and Mi-17 helicopters at Président Modibo Keïta-Sénou International Airport on Monday, 16 November 2026.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Mali: The National Defence Forces Equipped with New Aircraft
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Les Forces Nationales de Défense dotées de nouveaux aéronefs
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 16 November (AMAP) The official ceremony for the handover of new aircraft was presided over on Monday at Modibo Keïta – Sénou International Airport by the Transitional President, Army General Assimi Goïta, in the presence of civil and military authorities, AMAP reported. . This new batch of aircraft includes an Ilyushin Il-76 strategic transport aircraft, four Mi-8 utility helicopters and two Mi-24 attack helicopters.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Assimi Goïta equips the army with 7 new military aircraft, including 4 Mi-24 helicopters
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Assimi Goïta dote l'armée de 7 nouveaux appareils militaires, dont 4 hélicoptères Mi-24
article_manifest.summary: On Monday, 16 November 2026, the President of Mali's Transitional Government, Army General Assimi Goïta, presided over a ceremony at Bamako's Président Modibo Keïta International Airport to hand over new aircraft to the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa). This delivery covers seven aircraft. These include four Mi-24 attack helicopters, two Mi-8 utility helicopters and one Ilyushin Il-76 strategic transport aircraft.

article_manifest.title: Defence: Mali strengthens its air fleet with seven new aircraft
article_manifest.original_title: Défense : le Mali renforce sa flotte aérienne avec sept nouveaux appareils
article_manifest.summary: On Monday, 16 November 2026, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) took delivery of seven new aircraft to enhance their operational capabilities. Funded entirely from the national budget as part of cooperation with Russia, this equipment includes a strategic transport aircraft, four utility helicopters and two attack helicopters. .

article_manifest.title: GMS roundabout–Samé–Kati section: The...
article_manifest.original_title: Tronçon rond-point GMS–Samé–Kati : La...
article_manifest.summary: GMS roundabout–Samé–Kati section: The demolition of buildings and installations within the project's right-of-way begins this Monday, 16 November 2026. The demolition of buildings and installations located within the right-of-way of the GMS Roundabout–Samé–Kati section will begin this Monday The announcement was made by the Ministers of Transport and Infrastructure, Urban Planning, Housing, State Property, Regional Planning and Population in a joint statement released on Sunday evening.

article_manifest.title: Yanfolila: Two foreign nationals kidnapped in Dangouè
article_manifest.original_title: Yanfolila : deux ressortissants étrangers enlevés à Dangouè
article_manifest.summary: Two foreign nationals were abducted on Friday evening in Dangouè, in the commune of Gouaniaka, Yanfolila Cercle. According to the information gathered, armed men took them away at around 9 p.m. Since this kidnapping, no news of the two victims has been reported.

article_manifest.title: Niger: A new Director General at the head of the DGPN
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : Un nouveau directeur général à la tête de la DGPN
article_manifest.summary: Niamey, 16 November (ANP) – On Friday, 13 November 2020, the President of the Republic, Army General Abdourahamane Tiani, signed two decrees appointing the new Director General and Deputy Director General of the National Police (DGPN). This concerns Chief Police Commissioner Aboubacar Issaka Oumarou, Service No. 50 865, appointed Head of the General Directorate of the National Police (DGPN), and Divisional Police Commissioner Abdoulaye Maman Mijinyawa, Service No.

article_manifest.title: Defence: The FAMa are strengthening their fleet with new aircraft acquired using their own funds
article_manifest.original_title: Défense : Les FAMa renforcent leur flotte avec de nouveaux vecteurs aériens acquis sur fonds propres
article_manifest.summary: The official handover ceremony was presided over by the Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, Army General Assimi Goïta, in the presence of civil and military authorities. Fully funded from the national budget and acquired as part of cooperation with the Russian Federation, these aircraft are intended to increase the army's strategic mobility and logistical autonomy.

article_manifest.title: The Malian Air Force receives new helicopters and a transport aircraft
article_manifest.original_title: L’armée de l’air malienne reçoit de nouveaux hélicoptères et un avion de transport
article_manifest.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are strengthening their air fleet. On Monday, 16 November, the Transitional President and Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, Army General Assimi Goïta, presided over the handover ceremony for new aircraft at Modibo Keïta International Airport in Bamako, in the presence of the military hierarchy. .

article_manifest.title: AES: Ministers prepare for the upcoming summit in Ouagadougou
article_manifest.original_title: AES : les ministres préparent le prochain sommet à Ouagadougou
article_manifest.summary: The three countries reviewed the implementation of the Year II roadmap. Operational decisions are expected at the next College of Heads of State. The Extraordinary Council of Ministers of the Confederation of Sahel States met on 11 and 12 November in Ouagadougou.

article_manifest.title: GMS roundabout–Samé–Kati section: The demolition of buildings and installations within the project's right-of-way will begin on Monday, 16 November 2026.
article_manifest.original_title: Tronçon rond-point GMS–Samé–Kati : La démolition des constructions et installations dans l'emprise du projet débute ce lundi 16 novembre 2026.
article_manifest.summary: The announcement was made by the Ministers of Transport and Infrastructure, Urban Planning, Housing, State Property, Regional Planning and Population in a joint statement released on Sunday evening. According to the press release, this operation is part of the clearing of the rights of way essential for carrying out the dual carriageway development works on this important section of road.

article_manifest.title: Guinea deports 1,557 West African nationals after they were convicted of illegal gold mining
article_manifest.original_title: غينيا ترحّل 1557 مواطنا من غرب أفريقيا بعد إدانتهم بالتنقيب غير القانوني عن الذهب
article_manifest.summary: The Guinean authorities deported 1,557 citizens from West African countries, mostly from Mali and Burkina Faso, to their countries of origin, after they were convicted of illegal gold mining, according to Radio France Internationale. The radio station reported that the deportation operation took place on Saturday, 14 November, involving 44 vehicles and helicopters, and under tight security.

article_manifest.summary: Guinea-Mali border: 1,557 gold panners of various nationalities tried, pardoned and deported to Kourémalé On Friday, 13 November 2026, the Guinean authorities released 1,557 people of various nationalities who had been arrested at mining sites for illegal gold panning activities. . According to our information, all these individuals were tried by various Guinean courts before being pardoned by the Head of State and deported to the Malian border.

article_manifest.title: Guinea: Is JNIM threatening the country from Mali? What a field study reveals
article_manifest.original_title: Guinée : le JNIM menace-t-il le pays depuis le Mali ? Ce que révèle une étude de terrain
article_manifest.summary: On 25 October 2026, the Konrad Adenauer Foundation published a study on the establishment of JNIM, a group linked to al-Qaeda, in south-western Mali, on the border with Guinea. Conducted by the SITOC organisation in June and July 2026, the survey is based on 68 testimonies collected in south-western Mali and Upper Guinea. Local officials, representatives of civil society, security stakeholders, gold miners and transhumant herders were interviewed.

They were granted a pardon on Friday, 13 November 2020, and then taken to Kourémalé, on the border between Guinea and Mali, on Saturday, 14 November, by the Guinean authorities, with a view to returning them to their respective countries.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Mauritania, the Maghreb country most exposed to the crisis, according to the IEEE
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : la Mauritanie, pays du Maghreb le plus exposé à la crise, selon l'IEEE
article_manifest.summary: On 13 November 2023, the Spanish Institute for Strategic Studies (IEEE) published an analysis identifying Mauritania as the Maghreb country most directly threatened by the deteriorating situation in Mali. Authored by analyst Jaime Bello, the text specifies that his views do not represent the position of the Spanish Ministry of Defence. According to him, Nouakchott is under three pressures at once: a porous border, the terrorist threat and the mass influx of refugees.

article_manifest.title: Guinea: A government delegation from Mali visits Conakry
article_manifest.original_title: Guinée : Une délégation gouvernementale du Mali en visite à Conakry
article_manifest.summary: CONAKRY – A high-level ministerial delegation from the Republic of Mali arrived in Conakry on Tuesday, 10 November 2026. Led by the Minister of Mines, Professor Amadou Keïta, the delegation was welcomed on arrival by the Chief of Staff of Guinea's Ministry of Mines and Geology. This official visit is part of the Malian authorities' participation in the first edition of the Simandou Mining Summit, which is scheduled to open this Wednesday, 11 November, on Kassa Island, Africaguinee.com has learned from sources close to the department headed by Bouna Sylla.
